title: Remember a translation
description: Confirm the term, translation and collection for future use.
boundary_hint: Keep only the word or phrase you want to reuse. Review the prefilled sentence and narrow it to the intended term.
future_hint: Available for future translations that select this collection. Existing translations will not change.
duplicate: This translation already exists in the collection. View or approve it on the materials page.
conflict: This collection has another translation for the same term. Review which entry to use when checking your translation.
saved: Translation saved. Select its collection when translating.
